decisions.rationale: Anubis ransomware claim against Scholle IPN/SIG, a global packaging manufacturer (sig.biz). Real attack with potential supply chain impact. Already has its own candidate story.

Storm ransomware claim against WindRose Health Network (USA healthcare). Part of Storm's active multi-victim campaign. Healthcare targeting adds severity. Consolidates into the existing Storm story (5 prior events).
Storm ransomware claim against Westco Motors Cairns (Australia automotive). Same group, same MO, different sector/geo. Shows Storm's campaign breadth. Consolidates into existing Storm story.
